SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
FROM trader t
JOIN (
    SELECT tradereg
    FROM (
        SELECT tradereg, trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' AS risk_level,
               trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio' AS levratio,
               (voldaily / acctbal) AS dtr
        FROM trader
    ) AS trader_risk
    WHERE (levratio::FLOAT > 5.0 AND risk_level = 'Aggressive')
       OR dtr > 0.5
) AS high_risk_traders ON t.tradereg = high_risk_traders.tradereg
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
JOIN compliancecase cc ON tr.transreg = cc.transref
JOIN enforcementactions ea ON cc.compreg = ea.compref2
WHERE (ea.esclvl::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.acttake::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.resstat::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%'
    OR ea.penimp::TEXT ILIKE '%significant%')
    AND cc.lastrevdt >= DATE '2023-05-25';

WITH BlockedActions AS (
    SELECT 
        ea.enforcereg AS enforcement_action_id,
        ea.compref2 AS compliance_case_id,
        id.behansc AS behavioral_analysis_score,
        id.netansc AS network_analysis_score,
        (
            (
                (
                    id.behansc * 0.4
                ) + (
                    id.netansc * 0.6
                )
            ) * 100
        ) AS investigation_intensity_index
    FROM 
        enforcementactions ea
    JOIN 
        investigationdetails id ON ea.invdetref = id.invdetreg
    JOIN 
        compliancecase cc ON ea.compref2 = cc.compreg
    WHERE 
        ea.resstat != 'Resolved'
        AND cc.risksc > 0.5
)
SELECT 
    enforcement_action_id,
    compliance_case_id,
    behavioral_analysis_score,
    network_analysis_score,
    ROUND(
        investigation_intensity_index, 2
    ) AS investigation_intensity_index
FROM 
    BlockedActions;

WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT tradereg
    FROM trader
    WHERE (
        (trading_performance->>'tle' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(trading_performance->>'tle' AS DECIMAL) > 5.0)
        AND (trading_performance->>'risklevel' ILIKE '%Aggressive%')
        OR (trading_performance->>'dtr' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(trading_performance->>'dtr' AS DECIMAL) > 0.5)
    )
),
layering_spoofing_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trdref
    FROM transactionrecord
    WHERE (
        (risk_indicators->>'layerind' ILIKE '%Confirmed%')
        OR (
            (risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' AS DECIMAL) > 0.75)
            AND (risk_indicators->>'omi' IS NOT NULL AND CAST(risk_indicators->>'omi' AS DECIMAL) > 1.0)
        )
    )
),
intense_probes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON t.tradereg = hrt.tradereg
    JOIN layering_spoofing_traders lst ON t.tradereg = lst.trdref
)

SELECT 
    ea.penimp AS penalty_imposed,
    COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM 
    enforcementactions ea
JOIN 
    intense_probes ip ON ea.compref2 = ip.tradereg
GROUP BY 
    ea.penimp
ORDER BY 
    frequency DESC;

WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT tradereg
    FROM trader
    WHERE (
        trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive'
        AND CAST(trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio' AS DECIMAL) > 5.0
    )
    OR (
        -- Assuming 'dtr' is not present in the database, excluding it from the condition
        FALSE
    )
),
manipulation_candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT trdref
    FROM transactionrecord
    WHERE 
        risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Confirmed'
        OR (
            CAST(risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' AS DECIMAL) > 0.75
            -- Assuming 'OMI' is not present in the database, excluding it from the condition
            AND FALSE
        )
),
risky_traders AS (
    SELECT t.tradereg
    FROM trader t
    JOIN high_risk_traders hrt ON t.tradereg = hrt.tradereg
    JOIN manipulation_candidates mc ON t.tradereg = mc.trdref
)
SELECT AVG(a.patsim) AS mean_pattern_deviation_ratio
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN risky_traders rt ON a.translink = rt.tradereg;

WITH high_risk_traders AS (
    SELECT tradereg AS trader_id
    FROM trader
    WHERE trading_performance->>'risklevel' ILIKE '%high%'
),
significant_enforcement_actions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT compref2 AS case_id
    FROM enforcementactions
    WHERE CAST(esclvl AS TEXT) ILIKE '%legal%'
),
recent_compliance_cases AS (
    SELECT compreg AS case_id
    FROM compliancecase
    WHERE lastrevdt >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT t.trader_id
FROM high_risk_traders t
JOIN significant_enforcement_actions e ON t.trader_id = e.case_id
JOIN recent_compliance_cases c ON e.case_id = c.case_id;

WITH investigation_index AS (
    SELECT 
        compref, 
        ROUND(
            (0.6 * behansc) + (0.4 * netansc), 
            2
        ) AS iii
    FROM 
        investigationdetails
), 
network_mimic_traders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        trdref
    FROM 
        transactionrecord
    WHERE 
        risk_indicators @> '{"Networked Mimicry Risk": true}'
)
SELECT 
    c.*, 
    ii.iii AS investigation_index
FROM 
    compliancecase c
JOIN 
    investigation_index ii ON c.compreg = ii.compref
JOIN 
    network_mimic_traders nmt ON c.transref = nmt.trdref
ORDER BY 
    investigation_index DESC;

WITH likely_insider_trades AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.transref, 
        sf.infoleaksc AS original_leakage_score,
        (
            sf.infoleaksc * 0.6 + 
            (
                (
                    (
                        sf.newsscore + sf.socscore
                    ) / 2
                ) * 0.3
            ) + 
            (
                (
                    CASE 
                        WHEN sf.unuoptact = 'High' THEN 1
                        WHEN sf.unuoptact = 'Moderate' THEN 0.5
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ) * 0.1
            )
        ) AS sdlr_score
    FROM 
        sentimentandfundamentals sf
    WHERE 
        sf.infoleaksc > 30 -- Assuming 30 as a threshold for likely insider trades
)
SELECT 
    lit.transref, 
    tr.transtime, 
    lit.original_leakage_score, 
    lit.sdlr_score
FROM 
    likely_insider_trades lit
JOIN 
    transactionrecord tr ON lit.transref = tr.transreg
WHERE 
    lit.sdlr_score > 50; -- Assuming 50 as a threshold for pretty high SDLR score

WITH normalized_peer_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.abhvreg, 
        (ab.peercorr - AVG(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind)) / 
        NULLIF(STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) OVER (PARTITION BY t.tradekind), 0) AS normalized_peer_score
    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN 
        trader AS t ON ab.abhvreg = t.tradereg
)
SELECT 
    abhvreg, 
    COALESCE(normalized_peer_score, 0) AS new_peer_score
FROM 
    normalized_peer_scores;

WITH peer_correlation_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        t.tradekind, 
        AVG(ab.peercorr) AS avg_peercorr, 
        STDDEV_SAMP(ab.peercorr) AS stddev_peercorr
    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN 
        trader AS t ON ab.translink = t.tradereg
    GROUP BY 
        t.tradekind
),
peer_correlation_z_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.abhvreg, 
        ab.peercorr, 
        t.tradekind, 
        pcs.avg_peercorr, 
        pcs.stddev_peercorr, 
        (
            ab.peercorr - pcs.avg_peercorr
        ) / NULLIF(pcs.stddev_peercorr, 0) AS z_score
    FROM 
        advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN 
        trader AS t ON ab.translink = t.tradereg
    JOIN 
        peer_correlation_stats AS pcs ON t.tradekind = pcs.tradekind
)
SELECT 
    abhvreg AS id, 
    z_score AS new_score 
FROM 
    peer_correlation_z_scores;

WITH rawr_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.tradereg,
        t2.peercorr,
        (t1.trading_performance->>'winpct')::NUMERIC / 100 * 
            CASE 
                WHEN t1.trading_performance->>'risklevel' = 'Conservative' THEN 1
                WHEN t1.trading_performance->>'risklevel' = 'Moderate' THEN 2
                WHEN t1.trading_performance->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive' THEN 3
            END AS rawr
    FROM 
        trader AS t1
    JOIN 
        AdvancedBehavior AS t2
    ON 
        t1.tradereg = t2.translink
)
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN peercorr > 0.7 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS group_bool,
    AVG(rawr) AS avg_rawr
FROM 
    rawr_calc
GROUP BY 
    group_bool;

WITH trader_advanced_behavior AS (
    SELECT 
        t.tradereg, 
        t.trading_performance,
        ab.patsim AS pattern_anomaly_score,
        ab.peercorr
    FROM 
        trader t
    JOIN 
        AdvancedBehavior ab ON t.tradereg = ab.translink
),
trader_performance AS (
    SELECT 
        tradereg,
        (trading_performance->>'winpct')::NUMERIC AS win_rate,
        (trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'margpct')::NUMERIC AS margin_percentage,
        (trading_performance->'risklevel'->>'levratio')::NUMERIC AS leverage_ratio
    FROM 
        trader_advanced_behavior
),
risk_adjusted_win_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        tradereg,
        (win_rate / (margin_percentage * leverage_ratio)) AS rawr
    FROM 
        trader_performance
),
trader_group AS (
    SELECT 
        t.tradereg,
        t.pattern_anomaly_score,
        t.peercorr,
        CASE WHEN t.pattern_anomaly_score < 0.1 AND t.peercorr > 0.7 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_peer_copycat,
        ra.rawr
    FROM 
        trader_advanced_behavior t
    JOIN 
        risk_adjusted_win_rate ra ON t.tradereg = ra.tradereg
)
SELECT 
    is_peer_copycat AS group_bool_value,
    AVG(rawr) AS avg_rawr
FROM 
    trader_group
GROUP BY 
    is_peer_copycat;
